description: This file defines a static helper class CacheHelpers that provides utility methods for generating cache keys and managing cache duration within the Web layer of the eShopOnWeb project.

classes.name: CacheHelpers
classes.description: A static class containing methods to generate cache keys for catalog items, brands, and types, as well as a default cache duration.

methods.name: GenerateCatalogItemCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key string for a catalog item based on provided pagination and filter parameters.

methods.name: GenerateBrandsCacheKey
methods.description: Returns the cache key string used for storing brands.

methods.name: GenerateTypesCacheKey
methods.description: Returns the cache key string used for storing types.
